::: {.info}

# Noah Buckley

::: {.title}
Assistant Professor of Political Science
:::

::: {.affiliation}
[Department of Political Science](https://www.tcd.ie/Political_Science/), [Trinity College Dublin](https://www.tcd.ie)
:::

:::

I am an assistant professor (with tenure) in the Department of Political Science at Trinity College Dublin. I received my Ph.D. from Columbia University in 2017 and was previously a postdoctoral associate at NYU Abu Dhabi.

My research focuses on authoritarian politics and Putin-era Russian politics. How do autocratic regimes sustain themselves, how the mass public understands their authoritarian environment, and why corruption persists. I use quantitative methods and micro-level data in my research.

My work has appeared in the *American Political Science Review*, *American Journal of Political Science*, *Comparative Political Studies*, *Comparative Politics*, *Journal of Experimental Political Science*, *Europe-Asia Studies*, and *Post-Soviet Affairs*.

*(Looking for Noah M. Buckley-Farlee? That's me.)*
